text: From N=64 to N=128 (seeds 24-26, data_seed 0), trained force R2 falls 0.10-0.13 while trained distance R2 at the same layer 1 holds or rises (0.87-0.92 to 0.90-0.93). Since force = m2/r^2, is the lost force decodability the m2 factor? Does a linear probe for m2 at layer 1 lose a similar amount of R2 from N=64 to N=128?
